records.choice: B1 3-table schema (diaries, capsules, settings); UTC ISO 8601 instants, local-timezone calendar days, UUID ids
records.constraints: Phase 2 sync boundary. capsules.notification_id is a device-local handle excluded from sync.

records.choice: Soft delete (tombstone): blank title/content immediately and set deleted_at
records.constraints: All queries and counts filter deleted_at IS NULL. diaries.title stays nullable for tombstones.
records.reason: Carried from .talpi/spec.md Ledger (sync must propagate deletes).

records.choice: NOT NULL on diaries.{background_color,notebook_design,font_family,font_size,font_color,created_at,updated_at}, capsules.{diary_id,open_date,created_at}, settings.value; UNIQUE capsules.diary_id
records.constraints: Nullable stays: diaries.title, question_id, deleted_at; capsules.opened_at, notification_id. UNIQUE spans tombstoned diaries too. Keep idx_diaries_created_at. No CHECK constraints this cycle.
records.reason: Schema is the Phase 2 sync boundary; enforce invariants in the DB, not only in UI flow. Approved by Arden 2026-10-17.

records.choice: PRAGMA user_version ordered migrations; constraint changes via SQLite 12-step table rebuild, one transaction per step
records.constraints: user_version 0 = talpi v1 install or empty DB; both reach the final schema through the same path, final schema defined in one place. foreign_keys OFF outside the transaction, PRAGMA foreign_key_check empty before COMMIT, restore foreign_keys after. Failure = ROLLBACK, original DB untouched. migrate() runs every start and is a no-op at latest version. Supersedes dec-0004.
records.reason: SQLite lacks ALTER COLUMN; installed DBs need a reliable version marker. Approved by Arden 2026-10-17.

records.choice: Repair violating rows deterministically and let the migration succeed
records.constraints: Never delete diaries rows or diary content. diaries style NULL -> Conventions default style (#FFFDF7, lined, system, 20, #3A3A3A); created_at NULL -> updated_at else migration time; updated_at NULL -> created_at. Duplicate capsules per diary_id -> keep earliest created_at (tie: lowest id), do not cancel notifications of dropped rows. Capsule with NULL/dangling diary_id or NULL open_date -> delete row. capsules.created_at NULL -> migration time. settings.value NULL -> delete row.
records.reason: Aborting would leave the app stuck on the loading view. Approved by Arden 2026-10-17.

records.choice: Keep B2 DB interface unchanged; migration uses run('BEGIN')/COMMIT/ROLLBACK
records.constraints: Migration runs before DbProvider exposes the DB, so no interleaving. No transactions in normal app paths (Simplicity Zones).
records.reason: Avoid changing a hardened contract with two adapters.
